entries.title: AI-GA meta-evolution
entries.summary: Evolves small networks in a curriculum environment.
entries.expected: Champion genome and generation history; missing torch is explicitly reported as a stub.
entries.prerequisites: numpy, torch, gymnasium and pandas for actual training.
entries.limitations: Small research environment; optional bridge adapters are not proof of open-ended intelligence.

entries.title: Business v2
entries.summary: Runs planning, research and optional commentary agents in the legacy orchestrator.
entries.expected: Long-running orchestrator; stop with Ctrl+C. Configure its API_TOKEN and NEO4J_PASSWORD first.
entries.prerequisites: Repository dependencies and legacy orchestrator configuration; see the local README.
entries.limitations: Planning/research messages are fixtures. The compatibility SDK is not a live market-data integration.

entries.title: Business v3
entries.summary: Runs a bounded multi-agent business cycle with local fallback results.
entries.expected: One completed business cycle and its audit output.
entries.prerequisites: Repository demo dependencies; optional model/ADK services must be configured separately.
entries.limitations: The local fallback is simulated; no fundraising or real-world execution is established.

entries.title: Business v1
entries.summary: Ranks bundled business opportunities; service agents publish illustrative business events.
entries.expected: Best alpha opportunity and its sample score.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: No company incorporation, registration, funding or actual trade is performed.

entries.title: Insight v0
entries.summary: Searches a toy sector-scoring landscape.
entries.expected: Three episodes, best sector and a ranked table.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Scores are simulated, not forecasts or calibrated investment probabilities.

entries.title: Insight v1
entries.summary: Explores scenarios and Pareto search; optional browser GPT-2 performs real local text completion.
entries.expected: JSON scenario results. Browser mode also offers replay, local model and operator controls.
entries.prerequisites: Core dependencies for CLI; modern browser for the published interactive page.
entries.limitations: Simulated scenarios are not validated future predictions. GPT-2 is a small completion model.

entries.title: Marketplace
entries.summary: Validates a bundled job and can submit it to a configured legacy orchestrator.
entries.expected: A dry-run JSON job; remove --dry-run only after starting the documented local API.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: This is an API client and job fixture, not a deployed exchange or token settlement service.

entries.title: ASI world model
entries.summary: Explores generated grid worlds using a small learner and local API.
entries.expected: Local web service on port 7860; stop with Ctrl+C.
entries.prerequisites: torch, numpy, FastAPI and the demo requirements; CPU training can be slow.
entries.limitations: Grid-world research only; ASI and generalization beyond the tested environments are not established.

entries.title: Super Planner
entries.summary: Shows the stages and progress display of a planning interface.
entries.expected: Five progress stages and Plan Complete.
entries.prerequisites: Python and rich.
entries.limitations: The displayed stages are scripted; this demo does not compute a plan.

entries.title: Cross-industry discovery
entries.summary: Selects reproducible examples from the bundled opportunity catalog.
entries.expected: Two JSON sample opportunities; no ledger written.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Examples are canned; optional external generation is separate from verified discovery.

entries.title: Era of Experience
entries.summary: Extracts simple signals from bundled historical CSV samples.
entries.expected: Yield-curve and supply-chain sample signals with a heuristic selection.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Static historical samples, not current market data or recommendations.

entries.title: Finance Alpha
entries.summary: Provides paper-market agent and legacy service integration examples.
entries.expected: Use the browser sample or follow the Docker guide for the legacy service.
entries.prerequisites: Docker, curl, jq and access to the documented container image for the legacy launcher.
entries.limitations: The gallery uses sample traces. Live exchange connectivity and real P&L are not certified by the demo tests.

entries.title: GPT-2 CLI
entries.summary: Generates text with the actual GPT-2 124M model.
entries.expected: Generated text after the model has loaded.
entries.prerequisites: torch, transformers and roughly 550 MB model storage; first download requires network. Use --model-path PATH --offline with cached weights.
entries.limitations: CPU latency varies; this is a completion model, not an instruction-following assistant.

entries.title: Macro Sentinel
entries.summary: Computes Monte Carlo risk metrics from bundled macro samples.
entries.expected: JSON sample size and lower-tail VaR/CVaR.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Historical sample inputs and illustrative assumptions; no orders or hedge transactions.

entries.title: Meta-Agentic v1
entries.summary: Runs provider-driven code proposals, synthetic fitness and SQLite lineage.
entries.expected: Three generations saved to lineage.sqlite; repeat runs append safely.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: The mock provider and pseudo-accuracy are explicitly synthetic, not measured task performance.

entries.title: Meta-Agentic v2
entries.summary: Runs provider-driven code proposals, synthetic fitness and SQLite lineage.
entries.expected: Three generations saved to lineage.sqlite; repeat runs append safely.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: The mock provider and pseudo-accuracy are explicitly synthetic, not measured task performance.

entries.title: Meta-Agentic v3
entries.summary: Exercises proposal, validation, scoring and persistent lineage on a fixed identity task.
entries.expected: Two scored identity generations and a lineage database.
entries.prerequisites: Core Python dependencies for the fixture; Docker is required to evaluate any generated program.
entries.limitations: The offline fixture is not AZR model training. Cloud providers are explicit and can incur cost.

entries.title: Meta-Agentic tree search
entries.summary: Searches a small integer policy landscape.
entries.expected: Three logged search episodes and the best candidate.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Toy reward landscape; optional model rewriters do not establish trading alpha.

entries.title: MuZero planning
entries.summary: Runs a small MuZero-style planner in a Gymnasium environment.
entries.expected: Local dashboard on port 7861; stop with Ctrl+C.
entries.prerequisites: torch, gymnasium[classic-control], Gradio and the demo requirements.
entries.limitations: Small randomly initialized model unless trained; solving CartPole is not guaranteed.

entries.title: MuZero MCTS LLM concept
entries.summary: Preserves the original combined planning and model-integration concept.
entries.expected: Open the browser illustration. Read the source before using the preserved installer.
entries.prerequisites: The original installer requires obsolete optional packages and is not a validated install path.
entries.limitations: Use muzero_planning for maintained planning and the Agent operator for supported model/identity controls; original assets remain.

entries.title: OMNI smart city
entries.summary: Runs bounded smart-city episodes with local accounting.
entries.expected: Two episode outcomes; no token issuance. Simulation failure is reported as a nonzero exit.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: Simplified numeric city model, not a Unity digital twin. Local ledger entries are not on-chain AGIALPHA.

entries.title: Presentation assets
entries.summary: Preserved slide deck and PDF for the original demo vision.
entries.expected: Open the PDF or PPTX linked in this directory.
entries.prerequisites: A PDF or PowerPoint viewer.
entries.limitations: Slides describe the original vision; use this catalog for tested behavior.

entries.title: Repo-Healer
entries.summary: Provides repository-specific triage and isolated repair evaluation.
entries.expected: Follow the README benchmark commands. Review proposed repairs before applying them.
entries.prerequisites: Repository development dependencies and Docker for sandbox execution.
entries.limitations: Does not guarantee arbitrary failures can be repaired; the browser trace is illustrative.

entries.title: Governance simulation
entries.summary: Runs a bounded stochastic cooperation model.
entries.expected: Mean cooperation for the selected seed and assumptions.
entries.prerequisites: Python 3.11–3.13; source checkout and installed project dependencies.
entries.limitations: A simulation is not a proof of unique equilibrium, a security audit or an on-chain deployment.

entries.title: Sovereign agent concept
entries.summary: Preserves the original wallet-gated agent deployment concept.
entries.expected: Use the maintained alpha-agent operator guide for current identity, local model and AGIALPHA receipt controls.
entries.prerequisites: Legacy Solana/Phantom scripts remain for historical reference; they are not the canonical Ethereum AGIALPHA integration.
entries.limitations: Do not treat the old wallet UI or balance lookup as authenticated ownership. The current operator requires signed control and verified receipts.

entries.title: Shared demo utilities
entries.summary: Shared notices and isolated demo code evaluation helpers.
entries.expected: Import utilities as documented; this is not an independent agent.
entries.limitations: Supporting code, not a runnable business demo.
